item.title: Almost Periodic Characters and Hamel Coefficients in TVG Topologies on the Real Line
item.description: arXiv:2610.27633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study topological vector group topologies on the real line generated by Hamel coefficient functions and circle-valued characters. We determine their continuous characters, completions, and isomorphisms, and construct a sequence separating modular convergence from convergence of real-valued observations. We also classify precompact topologies and prove that no greatest nondiscrete topology exists. For the separate problem of a greatest compatible locally quasi-convex topology, we establish transfer and dilation criteria and rule out a family of dyadic counterexample constructions. The existence of a greatest compatible topology remains unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Irina Yaroshevskaya

item.title: Random $C^*$-subalgebras
item.description: arXiv:2610.28295v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Given a discrete countable group $\Gamma$, we introduce the concept of random subalgebras of the reduced group $C^*$-algebra $C_r^*(\Gamma)$. This extends the existing theory of invariant random subgroups and the one of invariant random subalgebras of the group von Neumann algebra ${\rm L}(\Gamma)$. As applications, we provide a characterisation of $C^*$-simplicity, a condition for amenability of the group and show the existence and uniqueness of a maximal nuclear $\Gamma$-invariant unital $C^*$-subalgebra of $C^*_r(\Gamma)$. Moreover, we give a topological characterisation of exactness of any separable unital $C^*$-algebra. Finally, we study exotic random subalgebras of $C^*_r(\Gamma)$ and super-exotic random subalgebras of ${\rm L}(\Gamma)$, that is, random subalgebras which do not arise purely from random subgroups of $\Gamma$ and not from random subalgebras of $C^*_r(\Gamma)$, respectively.
item.dc:creator: Pierre Fima, Hanna Oppelmayer, Leyan Tao

item.title: Levine Equivalence in Aura Topological Spaces: Reachability, Alexandrov Structure, and Quotient Frames
item.description: arXiv:2608.18269v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we study Levine equivalence in aura topological spaces. We show that the aura topology is determined by the reachability preorder induced by the scope function and is therefore an Alexandrov topology. We prove that the aura-Levine hull has the explicit representation $K_{\mathfrak a}(A)=\uparrow_{\mathfrak a}A=S_{\mathfrak a}^{\infty}(A)$, and hence two subsets are aura-Levine equivalent if and only if they have the same eventual forward spread. We also describe the quotient structure of the equivalence classes, characterize separation properties through the reachability preorder, classify scope functions that induce the same Levine equivalence, and examine preservation under aura-continuous mappings. For finite aura spaces, we provide an explicit procedure for deciding aura-Levine equivalence using the reflexive-transitive closure of the scope relation.
item.dc:creator: S. M. Elsayed, Tareq M. Al-shami

item.title: Just Previsions
item.description: arXiv:2605.10173v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Previsions are positively homogeneous functionals, and are generalized forms of integration functionals. We investigate previsions -- just previsions, not sublinear or superlinear previsions as in previous work. We show that every prevision can be expressed as an infimum of sublinear previsions, and as a supremum of superlinear previsions under mild conditions. This extends to homeomorphisms between spaces of previsions and certain hyperspaces over spaces of sublinear or superlinear previsions, which can also be characterized in terms of orthogonality relations, making the construction a variant of a double powerspace construction.
item.dc:creator: Jean Goubault-Larrecq
